messages:
elaine: Quick heads up — PR #7529 (kv-cache eviction tweak) just started failing snapshots on integration-shard-3 after the merge to main. Not seeing changes to tokenizer, so unsure if regression or flake. Can someone take a look before we consider updating snapshots?
ci-bot: Build failed: integration-shard-3 | job=7529-main-merge | failure: snapshot mismatch in tests/render/tokenizer.test.ts | run id=ci-20260412-3389
```
- Expected: <Token length 24>
+ Received: <Token length 23>
 at Object.equal (../__tests__/render/tokenizer.test.ts:42:12)
```
omar: I saw this in the CI UI — looks whitespace/order sensitive. PR didn't touch tokenizer itself but did change cache timing; could affect ordering. @tim any thoughts on rerun vs revert?
tim: Don't do a blind `--updateSnapshot`. My plan: 1) rerun shard-3 twice; 2) if both pass, assume flake and proceed; 3) if fails consistently, bisect or revert. I can kick off a rerun now.
tim: /rerun shard=3 --only-integration job=7529-main-merge
ci-bot: Rerun started (run id=ci-20260412-3390).
riyah: Also check for test seed — tokenizer has a random path in a helper. If tests aren't pinning TEST_SEED we might see nondeterminism.
omar: good call. quick grep shows `process.env.TEST_SEED` used in one helper; tests set seed in beforeAll for that suite, but timing might let it slip. will check.
ci-bot: Rerun complete: pass ✅ (ci-20260412-3390) — no snapshot diffs.
tim: promising. I'll run a second rerun.
ci-bot: Rerun started (run id=ci-20260412-3391).
ci-bot: Rerun failed: snapshot mismatch in render/tokenizer.test.ts (ci-20260412-3391)
```
- Expected: '["foo","bar","baz"]'
+ Received: '["foo","bar"]'
```
occurrence: 1 test.
elaine: Ugh — inconsistent across reruns. We should not update snapshots. Omar/Riyah can we try to reproduce locally (e.g., `yarn test render/tokenizer --runInBand` with NODE_ENV=ci)?
omar: reproducing locally now. I can hit it when I set NODE_ENV=ci and run with --runInBand; looks like a race on cache populate.
omar: Quick fix idea: add a micro-delay before reading cache in tokenizer to allow ordering to settle; will push a WIP if folks think that's acceptable.
tim: Prefer not to add arbitrary delays. If it's a race, fix ordering in cache population or ensure test pins seed. Could you push a WIP branch and mark it draft so we can review?
omar: Pushing WIP: branch `pr-7529-race-fix` now pushed, submitted as draft PR on top of #7529. @elaine pinged for visibility.
elaine: Thanks. I'll hold merge until the WIP lands and we get two approvals. If we can't fix quickly, we may revert the merge and reland after a clean fix.
riyah: I can review the WIP later today. If it's a deterministic ordering fix, we can fast-track it.
elaine: Plan summary: Omar pushes ordering fix WIP -> Tim & Riyah review -> hold main merge until green + 2 approvals. I'll update this thread with status. :thumbsup:
